messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sev2 — kv-paged allocator memory creeping on gpu-pool-us-west-2-3. Multiple OOMs and CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS reported, autoscaler is restarting containers. Trigger: paged-attn resident pages rising steadily, compaction skip rate high.

amy_oncall: taking oncall. starting handoff. I see restarts and node flaps in the past 40m. can someone paste the last 1h allocator logs? I'll cordon noisy nodes.

kevin_sre: logs pulled -> /var/log/runtime/allocator.log (tail):
```
WARN KV_PAGED: resident_pages=8421 -> 12894; compaction_skipped=312
ERR cuda: cudaErrorIllegalAddress in attention_paging.cu:700
INFO allocator: scheduled_reclaim=0; locked_pages=312
```

kai_runtime: quick mitigation plan:
1) set KV_COMPACTION_INTERVAL=30s for canary (force more frequent compaction)
2) reduce max_batch_tokens -> 512 for affected deployments to lower transient KV growth
3) temporarily enable fallback to quantized model-variant for heavy routes
4) enable kv-ttl=3600 to bound prefix growth until compaction catches up
roll canary, monitor resident_pages.

maria_support: customer-impact: noticed spike in 502/timeout for /v1/chat and embeddings since ~6187654000. S-tier customers reporting degraded UX. notifying CSMs and support queue.

jules_pm: ETA for roll? Do we need a customer notice?

amy_oncall: cordoning noisy nodes now and redirecting traffic off them. cmds:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --timeout=5m
```
I'll roll single-canary patch after cordon.

ops-bot: autoscaler:burst disabled for pool gpu-pool-us-west-2-3 (safety).

kevin_sre: pushing hotfix to allocator config: ALLOC_USE_SLAB_COMPACTOR=true, slab_compact_tries=10. will roll to one canary (node-19). also enabling guard on attention_pager to avoid illegal-address retry storms.

kai_runtime: also recommend immediate increase of KV_EVICT_RATE by 2x on the canary and set KV_CACHE_MAX_PAGES=12000 to avoid uncontrolled growth while we observe.

amy_oncall: canary deploy started (deploy id: rfd-alloc-2026-03-17-1) -> node-19. monitoring: resident_pages on canary stabilized vs baseline. latency impact within acceptable bounds.

maria_support: continuing to log customer reports. sending interim message to affected customers: "we're investigating increased errors and have applied mitigations; updates every 30m."

kevin_sre: note: older nodes still show slow-resident growth; compaction job hits locks on large pinned KV entries. plan: schedule rolling drain+compact overnight for remaining nodes if growth doesn't stop.

amy_oncall: update: after cordon + canary config, OOMs dropped from 6/hr -> 0 on canary. two other nodes still showing slow creep; I'll start staggered drains in 30m if stable.

incident-bot: Incident bridge created: https://meet/rdw-incidents/6187654321.

ops-bot: Incident timeline updated; auto-reminder in 15m.

amy_oncall: next update in 15m. current mitigation list: cordon noisy nodes, canary allocator flags, reduce batch size, kv-ttl, monitor. If customer impact persists escalate to exec-ops. :thumbsup:
